name: yiai-image
description: Generate and edit images with YiAI and your AigcRouter API key.

interface.shortDescription: Generate and edit images with YiAI
interface.longDescription: Generate and edit images through AigcRouter. Use Setup to configure your API key, Base URL, and default model in conversation. Supports exact image sizes and aspect ratios such as 16:9 and 9:16. Settings are saved locally and reused for subsequent requests.
defaultPrompt: Generate an image with YiAI-image and save it in my workspace.
Edit this image with YiAI-image and display the result.
Configure my YiAI-image API key, Base URL, and default model.
